newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan to auction federal investment bonds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan to auction federal investment bonds.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said on Wednesday it had invited bids up to Friday for the auction of three-year, five-year and 10-year maturity federal investment bonds.
The result of the auction will be announced on Saturday with settlement set for Monday, the bank said.

In the previous auction on June 6, the bank accepted bids worth 50 million rupees ($1.4 million) at par for three-years bonds and 195 million rupees at par for 10-year bonds. No bids were received for the three-year bond.
